actors.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
actors.role: Senator of Brazil and defeated presidential candidate
actors.blurb: Following his presidential election defeat, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro fled Brazil for the United States via Argentina and Ecuador despite a Supreme Court travel ban. His secret departure with his family has triggered legal fallout in Brasília, international visa scrutiny in Washington, and diplomatic friction across South America.

She is also managing the fallout from a cyberattack targeting parliamentary email accounts and navigating intra-coalition debates over military aid to Ukraine.

actors.name: Javier Milei
actors.blurb: President Javier Milei faces criticism after Argentine border authorities facilitated Flávio Bolsonaro's transit out of South America following his election loss in Brazil. Domestically and regionally, Milei continues to provoke controversy by refusing to congratulate Lula da Silva on his re-election and facing formal human rights complaints from Amnesty International over attacks on journalists.

actors.name: Marine Le Pen

actors.name: Santiago Abascal

Simultaneously, Vox has consolidated strategic Senate candidate pacts with the conservative Partido Popular ahead of general elections.
